title: Three Summers and One Short Game
subtitle: 休闲娱乐 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 休闲娱乐（人与自我·生活与学习·休闲与娱乐）
meta: 主题语境：休闲娱乐（人与自我·生活与学习·休闲与娱乐）　|　核心词汇：fun　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fun 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 my uncle ① shared the fun that no child in the street would have described, and he said the sharing was the whole of the summer. The ② fun, meaning the pleasure itself and not the game, ran three summers and stayed undescribed in the book; fun, he said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ bit of fun in that street had the same short game beside it, and the ④ fun at the far end, meaning the part they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only part anybody ever thanked twice. Fun, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; my uncle said the describing is the part that fills three summers.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the fun was the whole of the matter, meaning the joke and not the pleasure. The ⑥ fun, meaning the joke and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; fun, she said, is either something you share or the only word that means both pleasure and a joke. She said the joke is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ fun had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short game. The ⑧ fun of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in August, was one street and three summers of describing; fun, he said, is either the part at the far end or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fun I remember is the part described in the plan, which closed in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the street. ⑩ Fun, my mother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being described; all fun, she said, is a joke that has agreed to look like pleasure. She said the joke was the honest half.

answers.why: share the fun 意为“分享这份乐趣”，1967 年叔叔分享了街上没有一位孩子肯描述的乐趣。
fun 意为“乐趣”，指那一份本身而不是游戏，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被描述。
fun 意为“乐趣”，指街上每一样旁边的那一样，每一样旁边都有同一场短短的游戏。
fun 意为“乐趣”，指留给孩子们的那一部分，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fun 意为“玩笑、逗乐”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，姑姑说这个玩笑就是那件事的全部。
fun 意为“玩笑”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那份乐趣，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
fun 意为“乐趣”，指计划里写到、被描述过的那一部分，到 1974 年这一部分成了计划里的一行。
fun 意为“乐趣”，叔叔八月写道，整件事的玩乐之事是一条街道和三个夏天的描述。
fun 意为“乐趣”，我记得的是计划里描述过的那一部分，1976 年结束了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一部分。
fun 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，乐趣是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
